title: Extract dates
statusScope: PRJ-02 gate: real implementation moved, routes/project-dates.ts is a pure adapter, behavior matches baseline. Behavior parity was shown by a differential test against a fake in-memory DB (30 requests), not against a real database. typecheck, build and DB-backed tests did NOT run (see notRun), so TypeScript compilation of the new files is unverified.
workingTreeAtStart: Snapshot after PRJ-01 (decisions D1/D2 confirmed). Original upload kept in /tmp/orig for diffing.

oldToNewMapping.old: routes/project-dates.ts inline validation and update building

oldToNewMapping.new: projects/application/dates.ts listCalendar, listProjectDates, createProjectDate, updateProjectDate, deleteProjectDate

oldToNewMapping.old: lib/airdrop-reminder-cron.ts direct project_dates select and two updates

behaviorPreserved: All 5 route paths, methods, middleware chains and registration order unchanged (frozen surface check passes).
GET /projects/:id/dates and DELETE /project-dates/:id still have no try/catch.
400 messages, 404 message, 500 bodies with detail, and the log line on create are unchanged.
PATCH with an empty body still reaches the DB layer and returns 500, as before.

commands.command: negative tests N1-N5 on a scratch copy (db import in adapter, cron queries project_dates, domain imports infrastructure, repo imports application, delete auth changed)
commands.result: Each produced FAIL with the expected finding; restored copy PASS.

commands.command: node --test project-date.test.ts (scratch copy with .ts import extensions)
differential test: original project-dates.ts vs new adapter, express@4.21.2, esbuild bundle, fake DB (scripts/antas/projects/differential)
commands.result: 30 scenarios, 30 identical (status, body, log lines, resulting rows). Sanity: a deliberately changed message in the new bundle was detected (29/30).

notRun.reason: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile fails on this snapshot (ERR_PNPM_LOCKFILE_CONFIG_MISMATCH); no node_modules. New files were reviewed against lib/db/src/schema/projects.ts column types only.
tsx not installed; the same tests passed under plain node in a scratch copy.
No test database in this environment.
Only the diff was reviewed: two queries and two updates replaced by equivalent repo functions.
The repo's CI does not run test:finance-static either; left consistent.

risks: Typecheck has not been run. Expect it to pass (types match the schema) but it is unproven.
The differential fake DB covers only the query shapes these routes use.
nextSafeStep: Fix the install (lockfile overrides) and run pnpm typecheck / build / test:projects-static before PRJ-03, so the PRJ-00 baseline finally exists. Then PRJ-03: ratings and templates.
addendum: Added in PRJ-03: the same PRJ-02 code was later typechecked (0 errors) and built in a scratch copy, and its domain tests passed under tsx. See prj-03-evidence.json baselineNote.
